blockers.summary: SLH-DSA streaming multi-tile hypertree architecture designed using Row-1 Shared Memory Tiles (following phoenix-sdr-dsp). Decomposes layer-by-layer XMSS/WOTS+ verification within 4 KiB SRAM footprint without full-signature SRAM buffering. Verified 30/30 silicon cases bit-exact.

FN-DSA/Falcon verification decoupled to integer ring arithmetic in Z_12289[X]/(X^n+1), eliminating floating-point dependencies. Implemented authentic Draft FIPS 206 and Falcon Round 3 decoders (harmonizing 0x39 and 0x29 header bytes). BSS scratchpads allocated with stack_size=0x1800. Verified 30/30 silicon cases bit-exact on AMD Phoenix NPU.
3GPP TS 33.501 SUCI co-processor remediated; routed SUCI ciphertext directly into DR7 on-tile ML-KEM-512 decapsulation engine, deriving keys without host exposure. Verified 25/25 cases bit-exact.

X.509 PQ Certificates & CMS co-processor remediated; certificate signature verified with DR13 ML-DSA-44 on-tile verify, CEK unwrapped via DR7 ML-KEM-512 decapsulation using recipient private key. Verified 25/25 cases bit-exact.
TCG DICE / TPM Attestation co-processor remediated; attestation quote signatures verified using authentic DR13 ML-DSA-44 verify on-tile engine. Verified 25/25 cases bit-exact.

Formal verification remediated; replaced strided Python loop with exhaustive Z3 SMT proof obligations (QF_BV and QF_LIA) formally proving 4 core theorems UNSAT over unbounded mathematical domains. Verified 8/8 contract tests.
